intro.fr: Le NEO-TWEWY Randomizer de SaltContainer randomise NEO: The World Ends with You, y compris sur PC.
intro.en: SaltContainer's NEO-TWEWY Randomizer randomizes NEO: The World Ends with You, PC version included.

text.fr: Square Enix sort NEO: The World Ends with You en 2021.
text.en: Square Enix releases NEO: The World Ends with You in 2021.

text.fr: SaltContainer publie la version 0.1 le 30 octobre 2021, puis la 0.5 en novembre 2024, qui prend en charge la version PC malgré le chiffrement de ses fichiers.
text.en: SaltContainer releases version 0.1 on October 30, 2021, then 0.5 in November 2024, which supports the PC version despite its encrypted files.
